message.subject: Re: Where is my order ORD-20044
message.body:
Marco, yes it turned up. That's not the point.

I want it on record that getting a straight answer out of you lot took two goes. I tried your chat on Sunday the 13th and the assistant just sent me round in circles. Same tracking link, same "did that answer your question?", back to the start. No way to get through to an actual person. So I emailed on the Monday and didn't hear back until the Tuesday arvo, by which time the parcel was already sitting on my doorstep.

I pay $148 a month for this. I shouldn't have to chase twice to find out where my own order is. Either fix the chat or give people a way to reach a human.

Marcus Webb
0491 574 118

policy.label: Policy P2.2: Talking to a person and complaints
policy.text:
A patient can always talk to a person. Offer a call back at a time they choose, within 1 business day, or live chat during support hours. When a patient asks for a person, a team member writes the reply; there is no automated reply. Never make a patient ask twice, and never send them back to a help article instead.

Complaints: acknowledge within 1 business day, give the patient the name of the person who owns the complaint, and aim to resolve it within 10 business days. The team lead reviews every complaint. Complaints about clinical care go to the clinical lead, and complaints about privacy go to the privacy officer. If we cannot resolve a complaint, tell the patient how to contact the independent health complaints body in their country.

policy.label: Policy P5.4: Prices, price changes and concessions
policy.text:
Monthly plan prices. Australia: one product A$148, two products A$214; concession A$118 and A$171.

Price changes. We give at least 30 days' notice by email. A new price applies from the first billing date on or after the date it takes effect.

Concessions. About 20% off for holders of an Australian Pensioner Concession Card or Health Care Card, a New Zealand Community Services Card, or, in the UK, proof of a means-tested benefit such as Universal Credit. A concession is verified when it is added and re-verified every 12 months; we email a reminder 30 days before it is due. If it is not re-verified in time, the standard price applies from the next billing date, and the concession price returns from the next billing date after it is verified again. Patients re-verify by uploading their card or letter under Billing in their account. A new concession is added the same way, and the concession price applies from the next billing date after it is verified.

A change to the products on a plan changes the price from the next billing date. There is no referral programme and there are no discount codes.

policy.label: Policy P4.1: Delivery times by country
policy.text:
Every order travels with Courierline, tracked, and needs a signature on delivery. Delivery times are counted in business days from dispatch.

Australia, metro (capital cities and major centres such as Geelong, Newcastle and the Gold Coast): 1 to 3 business days. Australia, regional and remote: 3 to 6 business days.

The ETA shown on an order is the last day of this window. An order is not late until the ETA has passed. Tracking numbers start with CD, and the tracking link is in the dispatch email. We can only deliver within the country where the prescription was issued.
